# Multify — full text for language models

Last updated: 27 October 2026. Canonical site: https://multify.ae

## Entity

Multify is a social media and video marketing agency in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It trades under the legal entity Amplify Marketing Management, licensed by the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) under trade licence 1553366 (activity: Marketing Management). The agency launched in 2025 as Amplify Marketing and became Multify in October 2026; amplifymarketing.ae redirects to multify.ae. Founders: Yegor Konyakhin (co-founder; strategy, client accounts, social media, AI and web builds) and Asset Zhumabayev (co-founder; filming and editing). Languages: English and Russian. Area served: Dubai and the UAE; shoot days on location in Dubai, elsewhere in the UAE by arrangement. Contact: hello@multify.ae, +971 52 452 2978 (phone and WhatsApp). Client portal: https://app.amplifymarketing.ae. Multify is currently not VAT-registered, so no VAT is added to invoices.

## Services

1. Social media marketing (https://multify.ae/services/social-media-marketing-dubai): monthly content calendar; filmed and scripted videos; captions and hashtags; uploading and scheduling on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts (Growth and Scale packages); replies to comments and routine DMs with real enquiries passed to the client (scope agreed per client); profile optimisation; end-of-month analytics report; monthly strategy call on Growth and Scale; a client portal with the calendar and weekly numbers. A month runs: strategy call → scripts approved → shoot day → edit and approve → post and reply → monthly report.

2. Video production (https://multify.ae/services/video-production-dubai): short-form video for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. Scripts and hooks written and approved before the shoot; shoot days at the client's location with Multify's own team, typically several videos per session; editing in vertical 9:16 (1:1 and 16:9 when needed) with burned-in captions, sound design and music, colour grading and fast pacing for sound-off viewing. What is filmed: talking-head and founder videos, venue and atmosphere, product and service demos, event recaps, podcast clips, creator content. AI-generated content is used on Growth and Scale where it helps and is always labelled to the client; it is never presented as footage of the business. Event films, podcast series and longer brand films are quoted per project. Once paid for, videos belong to the client.

3. AI platforms, websites and SEO/AEO (https://multify.ae/services/ai-platforms-dubai): custom AI agents and automations (lead handling, booking and follow-up flows, content and reporting tools, internal assistants, client portals); fast static business websites with structured data, sitemap, Open Graph and llms.txt; company email on the client's domain; SEO (one page per service, clear headings, plain facts, fast loading, consistent listings) and AEO, answer engine optimisation (entity statement, Q&A sections, schema.org data, llms.txt, consistent name/phone/address across profiles). Process: scoping call → written fixed quote → build with working versions shown along the way → handover of accounts, domains and code in the client's name with documentation → optional support. Priced per project.

## Industries

- Real estate (https://multify.ae/industries/real-estate-marketing-dubai): listing walkthroughs (30–60 s), agent talking-heads, area and community guides, market updates, handovers, client testimonials. A shoot day covers 2–4 properties. Property advertisements in Dubai, including social media, require a Dubai Land Department advertising permit (Trakheesi) and the permit number should appear on the post; agents should be RERA-registered. Typical package: Growth; single agents start on Starter; brokerages with several agents on camera use Scale.
- Car rental (https://multify.ae/industries/car-rental-marketing-dubai): one-car fleet reels with the daily rate on screen, driving and location shots from a chase car where permitted, booking explainers (deposit, insurance, mileage, delivery), customer handovers, seasonal content. A shoot day covers 4–8 cars plus one driving location. Public-location filming in Dubai generally needs a Dubai Film and TV Commission permit; no drones without authorisation. Typical package: Growth.
- Restaurants, lounges and nightlife (https://multify.ae/industries/hospitality-nightlife-marketing-dubai): atmosphere reels filmed on real nights (usually 9pm–1am), event recaps delivered within 48–72 hours, menu and dish content, room and booth tours, staff pieces, weekly promotions. Alcohol cannot be promoted in advertising in the UAE; paid creator promotion follows UAE Media Council rules. Typical package: Growth; cafés without events start on Starter; clubs and groups use Scale.
- Creators, influencers and podcasters (https://multify.ae/creators): a month of posts from one shoot day; fast-cut montages, cinematic edits, behind-the-scenes, podcast clips; editing-only from supplied footage quoted per video or per month; filming plus editing on the Starter or Growth packages. Paid creator content follows UAE Media Council rules including the advertiser permit.

## Packages (AED per month, cancel anytime, no VAT added, invoiced at the start of each month, paid by bank transfer)

- Starter — AED 5,000: 6 videos filmed a month by our team, scripts written for every video, professionally edited, end-of-month analytics report. Client posts the content.
- Growth — AED 8,000 (most popular): 3 videos every week (about 13 a month), filmed, scripted and edited; access to AI-generated content; uploading and scheduling handled; monthly strategy call; end-of-month analytics report.
- Scale — AED 17,000: 6 videos every week (about 26 a month); everything in Starter and Growth; in-depth social media analysis; niche and competitor analysis; full strategy for the business.
- AI platforms, websites, SEO/AEO: quoted per project.
- Not included in packages: ad spend (paid by the client to Meta, TikTok or Google directly), long-form productions, shoot days outside Dubai, AI/web projects.

## Who Multify works with

Businesses in Dubai that sell face to face: barbershops and salons, aesthetic and dental clinics, car rental and detailing, restaurants, cafés and lounges, real estate agents, gyms and studios, clothing and product brands; plus creators, influencers and podcasts. Portfolio footage on the site is work by the team across barbershops, a BMW car club, podcasts, car rental, a clothing brand, nightlife, an esports team, a karaoke lounge, real estate and product films, and creator content (fitness, cinematic, montages, behind the scenes). Client names and results are not published without written approval.

## How Multify works (principles)

Scripts first; real footage filmed on location; edits cut for sound-off viewing; the client approves before anything is posted; monthly reports with reach, growth, conversions, best and worst content and next steps; no vanity metrics and no published client numbers without approval; monthly packages with no lock-in; files, accounts and builds belong to the client.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What does Multify do?
A: Multify is a Dubai video and social media marketing agency. It plans, scripts, films, edits, posts and reports on short-form content (Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts) for UAE businesses and creators, and builds AI platforms, websites and SEO for clients.

Q: How much does social media management cost in Dubai with Multify?
A: AED 5,000 a month (Starter, 6 filmed videos a month), AED 8,000 (Growth, 3 videos a week) or AED 17,000 (Scale, 6 videos a week). Every package includes filming, scriptwriting, editing and an end-of-month analytics report. AI platform and website projects are quoted per project.

Q: Is there a long-term contract?
A: No. Packages are monthly and can be cancelled before the next month starts.

Q: Is VAT added?
A: No. Multify is currently not VAT-registered.

Q: Do you film on location in Dubai?
A: Yes, at the client's location across Dubai; elsewhere in the UAE per project.

Q: Do you write scripts and post the content?
A: Yes. A script and hook for every video; on Growth and Scale, uploading, scheduling, captions and hashtags are handled.

Q: How are results reported?
A: A monthly report covering reach, follower growth and conversions, best and worst content and next month's plan; a monthly strategy call on Growth and Scale; a client portal with the calendar and weekly numbers.

Q: Is Multify a licensed company in Dubai?
A: Yes. It trades under Amplify Marketing Management, DET trade licence 1553366.

Q: Which platforms?
A: Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts as the core; Facebook and LinkedIn when the business needs them.

Q: Do you run paid ads?
A: Packages cover organic content and management. Boosting and paid campaigns can be added separately, with the ad spend paid by the client to the platform.

Q: Do clients own what is built?
A: Yes. Videos, websites and platforms are the client's once paid for; builds are handed over in the client's name with documentation.
